description: Create N 1C documents in parallel (1..100 per call). 1C does NOT support OData $batch — this is client-side parallel batching with concurrency cap and per-item success/failure reporting.

concurrency.description: Max parallel HTTP requests to 1C. Default 5 — safe for most 1C deployments.

document_type.description: Type of all documents (e.g. Document_РеализацияТоваровУслуг). Same type for the whole batch.

documents.description: Array of document payloads (1..100). Each item is the same shape as `create_document.data`.

name: batch_create_documents
